title: Judge it for yourself
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

Five links are waiting. Two of them are fakes. Click a link to see where it really goes before you decide.

playgroundTask.goal: You built a strong password and caught both fakes
playgroundTask.hint: The wording of a link means nothing — only the address underneath it counts. Look at what comes right before the first single slash. That is the real site.

steps.say: Build a password strong enough to reach the top rating.

drDigitalSuccess: You built a password no one is guessing and you read the real address behind five links. Those two habits stop most of what is out there.
drDigitalHint: A strong password is long and mixes letters, numbers, and symbols. For the links: read the address, not the words. Watch for odd endings and for zeros standing in for the letter o.
